title: The Pink Vanity Organisation List
intro: A vanity is organised or it is a drawer with a mirror. The travel vanity bag opens flat so the whole kit is visible, the covered acrylic organiser keeps dust off the palettes, the two-tier tray gives the perfume bottles a place to stand, the brush holder turns brushes into a detail shot, the hot pink organiser takes the overflow and the bow spa headband is the first thing on in every get-ready video. Nothing here touches your skin, so nothing here expires.

images.alt: Collage on pale lilac of an open pink travel vanity bag, a pink glitter brush holder, a clear two-tier perfume tray, a hot pink organiser, a pink bow spa headband set and a lidded acrylic organiser.
Woman in a pink knit cardigan at a cream vanity in a farmhouse bedroom, pink bow spa headband on, brushes in a pink glitter holder, perfume bottles on a clear two-tier tray, holding a pink tumbler.
